notes: Unresolvable district scopes (no queryable official boundary): KCDISTCRT, PTBA, SCHDST. Contests/measures scoped to them are hidden rather than shown to the wrong voters.

measures.title: County Council Meetings
measures.what_it_does: Requires the County Council to meet at least 45 times a year (instead of at least once in each of 50 weeks) and to offer remote attendance and public comment at meetings where public comment is required.
measures.cost_line: No tax or levy on the ballot; any cost is in county operations.

measures.title: Appointed Sheriff and Termination of Elected Sheriff
measures.what_it_does: Makes Sheriff an appointed office: the Executive appoints and a Council majority confirms; the current elected Sheriff's term ends January 1, 2027.
measures.cost_line: No tax or levy on the ballot; any cost is in county operations.

measures.title: Public Safety Ombuds
measures.what_it_does: Creates an executive department of Public Safety Ombuds, appointed by the Council from a panel's list, to oversee the Sheriff's Office, plus a Community Advisory Committee.
measures.cost_line: No tax or levy on the ballot; any cost is in county operations.

measures.title: Initiative Procedures
measures.what_it_does: Gives county initiative sponsors 180 days instead of 120 to collect signatures.
measures.cost_line: No tax or levy on the ballot; any cost is in county operations.

measures.title: Four Year Budget Outlook
measures.what_it_does: Requires the Chief Financial Officer to prepare a four-year budget outlook showing projected Current Expense Fund spending will not exceed projected available funds.
measures.cost_line: No tax or levy on the ballot; any cost is in county operations.

measures.title: Nondiscrimination
measures.what_it_does: Rewrites the Charter's nondiscrimination clause to list sex, race, color, national origin or ancestry, creed, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, genetic testing results, family caregiver status, pregnancy, childbirth or lactation, and military or veteran status.
measures.cost_line: No tax or levy on the ballot; any cost is in county operations.

measures.title: Juvenile Detention
measures.what_it_does: Creates a Juvenile Detention Advocate Office to take complaints and monitor conditions, and requires an independent audit or accreditation review of juvenile detention at least every five years.
measures.cost_line: No tax or levy on the ballot; any cost is in county operations.

measures.title: Additional Sales and Use Tax for Police and Public Safety
measures.what_it_does: Raises Milton's sales and use tax by 0.1% from 2027 for public safety purposes allowed by RCW 82.14.450, such as police staffing.
measures.cost_line: Sales and use tax up 0.1% (one cent on $10) from 2027; 15% of proceeds go to the county.

measures.title: Public Safety and Town Operations and Services Levy
measures.what_it_does: Lifts South Prairie's regular property tax levy for police, fire, EMS, parks, roads and other town services.
measures.cost_line: About $1.33 per $1,000 more (to a maximum $2.90 per $1,000) for 2027, then up to 6% a year through 2032.

measures.title: Maintaining and Expanding Local Transit Service Sales and Use Tax Increase
measures.what_it_does: Adds a 0.3% sales and use tax from April 1, 2027 to maintain and expand Pierce Transit bus service and fund fare-free rides for seniors and youth.
measures.cost_line: Sales and use tax up 0.3% (three cents on $10) within Pierce Transit's service area.

measures.title: Safe Homes for All Initiative Measure No. 1
measures.what_it_does: Amends Tacoma's rental housing code: tenant unions and good-faith bargaining, landlord licensing with per-unit fees, City and private enforcement, penalties and business-license revocation.
measures.cost_line: No tax; landlords pay new per-unit rental licensing fees, and the City takes on new enforcement and program costs.

measures.title: Emergency Medical Services Property Tax Levy
measures.what_it_does: Renews Riverside Fire & Rescue's EMS property tax levy for six years from 2027.
measures.cost_line: Up to $0.50 per $1,000 of assessed value (at most $50 a year per $100,000), the same rate as the expiring 2020 levy.

measures.title: School Construction and Replacement Bonds
measures.what_it_does: Authorizes up to $491 million in 20-year bonds to build a new middle school and replace Cascade Middle School and Alpac Elementary.
measures.cost_line: Up to $491,000,000 in bonds repaid by excess property taxes.

measures.title: Educational Programs and Operations Maintenance Levy
measures.what_it_does: Two-year levy (2027-2028) to maintain Yelm Community Schools programs and operations not funded by the State.
measures.cost_line: Up to $11,194,449 in 2027 and $12,278,072 in 2028, an estimated $1.50 per $1,000 of assessed value.
